race.comment: GOLD LILLY (4) ran over the top to score at this track and trip a fortnight ago in an impressive win. Pike now takes the ride, replacing the apprentice hoop and judging by his latest effort, the wide draw is no issue. Can circle around them and bring up back-to-back wins. TIGER TANK (2) is building toward another win, missing by 1.8L at this track and trip last time out after settling near the tail of the field. He had settled closer in the runs prior and the inside barrier can see him in the firing line today. Racing well and can get back to winning ways. VIRESHA (5) has disappointed her past couple, but they've been over further. She was beaten in a photo the last time she raced at 1200m and it maps for her nicely again today. Expecting a better effort. MORF (1) can give a bold sight from the front. SLIPPERY FISH (3) is better than he's shown her past couple and won't be far away.
